scope: Additive synthetic-fixture-only owner snapshot contract. No migration, schema/admission/replay/lifecycle change, payload access, USI activation, network, provider, private-data, deletion or live action.
hash: S=odysseus.harbour.knowledge_migration_snapshot.v1. C(v)=ASCII canonical JSON ensure_ascii=true, allow_nan=false, sorted keys and comma/colon separators. H(v)=sha256:hex(SHA256(uint64_be(len(C(v)))||C(v))). D(k,v)=H({schema_id:S,kind:k,value:v}). Existing stored revision_digest verifies only as H(R); every new domain digest uses D.

inputs.R: exact decoded _revision_record mapping excluding stored revision_digest; preserve all keys, nulls and sequence order
inputs.T: exact _head_dict(_head_from_row(head_row)) mapping; require agreement with R on owner, knowledge id, kind, current revision id and payload digest

record_and_boundary: Metadata copies revision=R.revision, generation=T.generation, state=T.state, knowledge_kind=R.knowledge_kind and payload_sha256=R.payload_sha256 without rehash. record_digest=D(head_record,{owner_ref_digest:O,metadata:M}), where M is exactly the preceding fourteen fields. Outer heads sort only by (knowledge_id_digest,revision), duplicate knowledge ids reject. B=D(head_boundary,{owner_ref_digest:O,record_digests:L}); snapshot_digest=D(snapshot,{schema_id:S,owner_ref_digest:O,captured_head_boundary:B,heads:A}). A is all complete fifteen-field records. Empty is L=[] and A=[], never null/sentinel/timestamp.
validation: All v2 type, byte, count, owner-filtered deferred-read and cleanup rules remain required. Golden vectors use literal inputs plus hashlib/json only. Wrong stored H(R), domain swapping, dropped null, double hash, raw JSON hashing, changed R/T fields, wrong owner, duplicate/disordered heads and payload access each fail closed.
